theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cone_constant_density_planar
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (p : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → p ∈ C.support → p ≠ 0 → 0 < δ → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball p δ → HasMassDensity C y k) → ∃ (δ' : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ' ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ p ∈ Q ∧ C.support ∩ ball p δ' = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ' ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball p δ' → C.massOn W = (k : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P)))
